params.label: Alignment channel
params.requiredMessage: Select the channel used to align cycles
params.tip: Shared marker across cycles — first selected image is the reference

params.label: 2D affine (MIP)
params.tip: Register the max-intensity Z projection — fast and usually enough

params.label: 3D affine
params.tip: Full 3D volume registration — slower, needed for real Z misalignment

params.label: FFT initialisation
params.tip: Seed the search with a phase-correlation shift — helps when the initial offset is large

params.label: Ignore physical spacing
params.tip: Treat every pixel as isotropic — matches the old-R default

params.label: Auto mask
params.tip: Restrict the optimiser to non-background pixels

params.label: Sigma
params.tip: Gaussian smoothing before registration — higher tolerates more noise

params.label: Samples per parameter
params.tip: How many pixels the optimiser sees per transform parameter
